subject: social_studies
concept: Researching an issue from multiple stakeholder perspectives before proposing any response
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps out the different stakeholders affected by their chosen issue and each one's interests
exercise.abstract: Student researches and presents at least two genuine stakeholder perspectives on their chosen issue

misconception_flags: presents only one stakeholder's view as if it were the only relevant perspective

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
